name: Survival waves
reference: Quest 140 goal 278 "Survive the assault to unlock the next level" counts 3 (client): 3 waves. Live Monster Laboratory (8030, same arena): the pads showed particle 542337 for 2.0 s, then the wave came; the next wave came once a wave was down.
comment: Started by lost_creations.rs when the start gate opens. Each wave cleared counts 1 of 3; the third completes the objective. The enemies are per level variant (spawns.json).
